MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire HD tablet adds a portable way to watch video, which complements my television setup without duplicating its role.",
    "The smart plug and Echo Dot with a clock offer practical additions to my connected home: controlling a lamp and having bedside Alexa access with a visible clock."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The earbuds and Echo Auto address listening on the go and in-car use, while my recent purchases focus on video and security at home.",
    "Another HD Fire TV Stick adds little because I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television. The other Echo Dots interest me, but I would choose only the clock version.",
    "The memory card could support my video recording, but I cannot choose it confidently without checking compatibility with my Canon camera."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in Fire TV seems to have been extended too broadly to Amazon devices, even when they serve a different setting or duplicate equipment I own.",
    "Buying electronics does not mean I currently need personal audio accessories; the purpose of the device matters more to me than that broad connection."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: useful additions should extend my home setup rather than repeat streaming functions I have covered.",
    "Specific practical details influence my choice, such as the clock on a bedside speaker or whether a storage card works with my camera."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my home video and connected-home interests, but missed the distinction between useful additions, duplicates, and devices for needs I have not shown."
}
